title: The signing keychain setup makes both of its passwords and puts the signing keychain first on the search list
steps: S1: Take `set -euo pipefail` and the one-line `random()` from packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/build/setup-signing-keychain.sh and run them in bash, calling random twice the way the script does.
S2: Read the two values printed.
S3: In the same script read how it sets the user's keychain search list.
expect: S2: two different strings of 40 hex digits.
S3: the list starts with the signing keychain (`LIST=("$KEYCHAIN")`) and is set with `security list-keychains -d user -s "${LIST[@]}"`.
evidence: 10/10/2026 on the iMac: the first run wrote only tracy-signing-keychain.pass and exited 141 (tr SIGPIPE under pipefail) with no keychain and no .p12
fence: The script's own shell options and password maker, run as written
